name: Fire Formation - Domei
card_text: When this card is activated: You can Ritual Summon 1 Beast-Warrior Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. If this face-up card is sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY: You can target 1 "Fire Fist" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Fire Formation - Domei" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Fire Formation - Domei" per turn.
